description: Version 2.1 of the generalist gripper (gripper plus handles line): the 1.17 gripper plus the loop attachment. Builds on 1.17 (pebble voice-cfdf2d31: fingers same thickness along whole length) — wait for/use that version. The attachment is a small, black, flat piece that slides into the gripper and has two slots for loops (straps). No camera attachment. Closely match the reference images — key photo cad/reference/generalist_gripper_gen6_closed.png, plus the other references under cad/reference and references/generalist. Model in OpenSCAD with every piece separable: each part its own module and its own exported STL, viewable individually and together in the live preview. Use the repo's dual-render workflow (cad/compare: three.js vision render + OpenSCAD STL, same angles, diffed; STL is truth). Versioning scheme is in AGENTS.md.
summary: Model gripper version 2.1 in OpenSCAD as the 1.17 gripper plus a small, black, flat sliding loop attachment with two strap slots. Match the reference images, with each part its own module and STL, viewable alone or together.
